decisions.reason: The safety shoe line rests on the firm's core in-house design and manufacturing knowledge, so management can read market feedback and refine the models rather than withdraw them.

The comfort insole draws on the firm's foot-measurement and footwear expertise, but after the supportive insole was withdrawn the overlapping insole range may be consolidated, which raises its risk somewhat.
The ergonomic series has its own page and combines core shoe competence with the firm's ergonomics development, giving it strong capacity for learning and improvement.
Firefighter boots extend the firm's materials and certification know-how into a demanding niche, and the certification investment already made argues for keeping and refining the line.

The moulded insole is the flagship that links the firm's measurement tools, training services and footwear knowledge, so it is strategically central and likely to absorb resources from the dropped insole.
